'''Bevos Zorr''' was a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] working for [[Galentro Heavy Works]]. He was present on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the wake of the Imperial [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] to help his boss, [[Wyrn Otro]], win a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] contract.<ref name="Game" />
